# ADR-0003 – Hidden Truth of the Game World

## Context

The player initially experiences the world as a genuine, destroyed home. The later realization should recontextualize the entire journey and initiate the endgame.

## Decision

The base game's playable world is a Constructed World created by Jator and Semm within Tatok. The hero is a deceased soul from Era and does not know this at the beginning. The construct exists to cultivate an exceptionally powerful heroic soul.

## Consequences

- Early content may foreshadow the truth, but must not prove it unambiguously too soon.
- The Talisman gradually deciphers the facade.
- The revelation unlocks the Soul Energy system and the return phase.
- The emotional significance of rescued inhabitants and places remains intact despite their artificial origin.
